claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants access to an existing spell but changes how that granted cast is maintained. The current spell-access surface can override DC and targeting, but it cannot say that a normally concentration-based spell no longer requires concentration when cast through the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.durationBoundToGrantedSpell
